description: This file is a React component implementing the Login and Signup user interfaces, including form handling, validation, MFA, and navigation logic for the Applicant Portal's Login page.

methods.name: useQueryMode
methods.description: Custom hook to determine the mode ('login' or 'signup') based on URL query parameters.

methods.name: validateEmail
methods.description: Function to validate email format using a regex.

methods.name: Input
methods.description: Reusable input component with label, icon, error display, and optional right-side element.

methods.name: PrimaryButton
methods.description: Styled button component with hover and tap animations, disabled state handling.

methods.name: LoginForm
methods.description: Component managing login form state, validation, MFA, and submission for user sign-in.

methods.name: SignupForm
methods.description: Component managing signup form state, validation, and submission for new user registration.
